Hero.title: From <important>Script to Short</important>, to YouTube to Shorts, All in One Place.
Hero.description: VidStack is the all-in-one AI video automation platform. One tool, every video need — script to video, long video to shorts, AI avatars, auto-publish, and scheduling.

Features.section_description: Everything you need to automate your video workflow, from first draft to published short.
Features.feature1_description: Drop in a YouTube URL or upload a video. AI extracts the best hooks and auto-clips viral moments.
Features.feature2_description: Type an idea, get a finished video. Hook, body, and CTA written by AI, rendered automatically.
Features.feature3_description: Smart 16:9 to 9:16 reframing that keeps the speaker perfectly centered, frame by frame.
Features.feature4_description: Generate AI presenters and natural voiceovers in any language — no camera, no mic needed.
Features.feature5_description: Automatic B-roll matched to your script, plus word-level animated subtitles that boost retention.
Features.feature6_description: One click publishes to TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram — or schedule posts for peak times.

Pricing.section_description: Start free, scale as you grow. No watermark, cancel anytime.

FAQ.question1: How does VidStack turn a long video into shorts?
FAQ.answer1: Paste a YouTube URL or upload a video. VidStack transcribes it with Whisper, finds the strongest hooks with AI, then auto-clips and reframes the best moments into 9:16 vertical shorts with face tracking.
FAQ.question2: Can I create a video from just a script or idea?
FAQ.answer2: Yes. Type your idea and VidStack's 4-step AI pipeline writes the hook, body, and CTA, generates a voiceover, finds matching B-roll, and renders a ready-to-post video.
FAQ.question3: Which platforms can I publish to?
FAQ.answer3: TikTok, YouTube Shorts, YouTube long-form, and Instagram Reels. You can publish instantly or schedule posts ahead of time.
FAQ.question4: What AI models does VidStack support?
FAQ.answer4: Gemini, GPT-4o, Claude, and DeepSeek. Switch between them per job depending on cost and quality needs.
FAQ.question5: What video formats can I export?
FAQ.answer5: 9:16 vertical for Shorts and Reels, 16:9 horizontal for YouTube, and 4:5 square for feeds — all from the same project.
FAQ.question6: Is there a watermark on the free tier?
FAQ.answer6: No. VidStack never adds a watermark on any plan, including the free 30 clips per month tier.
